lines_of_business: Cigna-administered plans; 'Coverage for panniculectomy and abdominoplasty varies across plans.'
criteria_location: Coverage Policy, pp.2-3 only; ~1.5 pages. Coding Information p.3-4.

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'not medically necessary for ANY other indication, including ...' list (neck/back pain, cosmesis, psychological, with other abdominal/gyn procedures unless separately met).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The pannus is causing persistent intertriginous dermatitis, cellulitis, or skin ulceration, which is refractory to at least three (3) months of medical management, including all applicable treatments. ... treatment should include topical antifungals, topical and/or systemic corticosteroids, and/or local or systemic antibiotics.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'all applicable treatments' versus 'and/or' list; 'should include' is hortatory not mandatory.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Note: If the procedure is being performed following significant weight loss, in addition to meeting the criteria noted above
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Conditional extension in a Note; 'significant weight loss' undefined, so the branch trigger is unclear.

requirement_kinds.quote: The following demonstrated on preoperative photographs: The pannus hangs at or below the level of the symphysis pubis
persistent intertriginous dermatitis, cellulitis, or skin ulceration, which is refractory to at least three (3) months of medical management
In addition to good hygiene practices, treatment should include topical antifungals, topical and/or systemic corticosteroids, and/or local or systemic antibiotics
presence of a functional deficit due to severe physical deformity or disfigurement resulting from the pannus
The surgery is expected to restore or improve the functional deficit; The pannus is interfering with activities of daily living
panniculectomy should not be performed until at least 18 months after bariatric surgery and only when weight has been stable for at least the most recent six months
preoperative photographs; history and physical examination

thresholds.quote: hangs at or below the level of the symphysis pubis

stable for at least six months
at least 18 months after bariatric surgery

time_windows.what: Stable weight after significant weight loss
time_windows.quote: stable weight for at least six months
at least 18 months after bariatric surgery
